title: Pocket Totem
description: Pocket Totem — a lightweight Vanilla+ mod that allows the Totem of Undying to trigger from any inventory slot, keeping your off-hand free for shields and tools.
body:
# 🛡️ Pocket Totem — Passive Immortality!

Have you ever lost all your netherite gear in lava just because you forgot to put the Totem of Undying in your off-hand? Or are you tired of constantly sacrificing your shield just to stay safe? **Pocket Totem** solves this problem once and for all!

This lightweight, Vanilla+ mod unlocks the true passive magic of the totem, allowing it to protect your life directly from the depths of your backpack.

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **🧳 Pocket Salvation** — The totem automatically triggers from **absolutely any slot** in your player inventory. 
* **⚔️ Total Off-Hand Freedom** — Free up your hands! Safely carry shields, torches, maps, or dual-wield weapons while remaining fully protected.
* **🔮 100% Vanilla Sync** — No stripped mechanics. Upon activation, it triggers the original full-screen golden flash animation, vanilla status effects, and sounds.
* **🏆 Advancement Supported** — Unlike poorly optimized scripts, this custom code hooks perfectly into the game server to award you the official **"Postmortal"** advancement.

---

## ⚙️ Smart Anti-Bug Logic (How It Works)

We made sure the mod runs flawlessly without breaking any vanilla mechanics or causing item dupe bugs:
1. **Hand Priority:** If you are holding a totem in your main or off-hand, standard Minecraft code takes over. The inventory scan only triggers if your hands are busy. This **100% prevents the "double-spending" bug** where one hit could accidentally consume two totems.
2. **Ultimate Optimization:** The code caches the inventory size and triggers *only at the microsecond of death*. It does not run on every game tick, ensuring **zero impact on server performance or FPS**.

---

## 🚀 Setup & Environment

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** This is a hybrid mod (**Side: BOTH**). It must be installed **on both the server and the client**. The client handles the screen flash rendering, while the server securely cancels the death event and updates the inventory slots.

* **Mod Loader:** NeoForge
* **Supported Versions:** 1.21.4 - 1.21.8+
